title.narrative: Mobilizing climate finance to support socio-economic development and climate action in Pakistan

description.narrative: After successfully creating a discourse around carbon markets and its needs in Pakistan during the last phase of the project, this project seeks to support the implementation of carbon markets in Pakistan for equitable development by building capacity of the private sector entities, addressing the disconnect between different stakeholders, and developing a nation-wide outreach plan through assorted media campaign. It aimed to integrate sustainability into economic policies, aligning with different SDGs

The project aims to foster the socio-economic progress, equitable development and climate resilience in Pakistan by building capacity and partnerships for implementation of carbon market projects. Through close collaboration with the Ministry of Climate Change and Chambers of Commerce and Industry (CCI), it further seeks to improve the nation-wide discourse around climate finance and equitable markets through workshops, media campaign, and a concerted communications strategy.
